use_case_name: Decorrelate Diverging Air or Surface Tracks

claims.content: The C2 JU automatically or manually decorrelates air or surface tracks that were previously correlated but have diverged beyond specified criteria, ensuring accurate track separation and preventing false associations.

goal.raw_text: The C2 JU automatically or manually decorrelates air or surface tracks that were previously correlated but have diverged beyond specified criteria, ensuring accurate track separation and preventing false associations.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU must have an automatic decorrelation capability for real-time air or surface tracks.
Automatic decorrelation tests shall be performed for each common local track upon receipt of each J2 or J3 message on the track.

Common local tracks shall be decorrelated if, on receipt of consecutive remote track reports, the remote track falls outside a specified distance threshold (1.5 times the maximum correlation distance).
The C2 JU must be capable of performing correlation and decorrelation of local track data with respect to received remote data to prevent dual designations.
If a manual correlation was previously accepted, the resulting track shall not be subject to automatic decorrelation processing for a period of 5 minutes.

The C2 JU initiates decorrelation of diverging air or surface tracks upon receipt of consecutive remote track reports (J2 or J3 messages) where the remote track falls outside a specified distance threshold (1.5 times the maximum correlation distance).

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU initiates decorrelation of diverging air or surface tracks upon receipt of consecutive remote track reports (J2 or J3 messages) where the remote track falls outside a specified distance threshold (1.5 times the maximum correlation distance).

claims.content: After determining that a common local track satisfies the criteria for automatic or manual decorrelation, the local track is automatically tested once for correlation against remote tracks (excluding common local tracks) in accordance with specified correlation paragraphs.
If the automatic correlation test fails, a new Track Number (TN) is assigned to the local track, and this new TN is reported in a J3.2 or J3.3 message.
The Retained TN and the Dropped TN are decorrelated, meaning that if subjected to the decorrelation criteria again, the tracks would decorrelate, and the correlation is rejected.
C² JUs may perform manual decorrelation and may have a capability to require manual confirmation of automatic decorrelations.
If the automatic correlation test fails during decorrelation execution, a new Track Number (TN) is assigned to the local track and reported in a J3.2 or J3.3 message.
When a C² JU recognizes two tracks eligible for correlation, it shall initiate action either automatically or manually to resolve the dual designation by transmitting a J7.2 Correlation message.

Receiving IUs shall accept the requested correlation unless certain prespecified conditions exist which require or allow the receiving IU to reject the requested correlation or respond with a reverse correlation request.
Whenever a correlation request is rejected, the J7.2 message with the RV field set to value 2 shall be transmitted to report the rejection.
When the RV field is set to value 3, it indicates the correlation was manually initiated and shall be accepted unless certain conditions apply which require rejection.
C² JUs receiving or generating a J7.2 message with RV=2 (Correlation Rejection) shall not automatically originate a request with the same Retained TN and Dropped TN for a period of 2 minutes.
When a correlation request is rejected for a manual correlation, the JU originating the request shall provide an operator alert as a cue to conduct voice coordination.
After acceptance of a manual correlation, the resulting track shall not be the subject of automatic decorrelation processing for a period of 5 minutes.
If the automatic correlation test fails during the execution of decorrelation, a new Track Number (TN) is assigned to the local track and reported in a J3.2 or J3.3 message.
The Retained TN and the Dropped TN will decorrelate; if subjected to the decorrelation criteria once, the tracks would decorrelate, and in this case the correlation shall be rejected.

If there is an OCC on the Dropped TN and the received RV field is set to value 0, the reverse correlation shall be transmitted if the new Dropped TN has no correlation constraint; if both the Retained TN and Dropped TN have an OCC, the correlation shall be rejected.
If there is an OCC on the Dropped TN and the received RV field is set to value 1, the correlation shall be rejected.

C² JUs receiving or generating a J7.2 message with the RV field set to value 2 (Correlation Rejection) shall not automatically originate a request with the same Retained TN and Dropped TN for a period of 2 minutes.
When a correlation request is rejected for a manual correlation, the JU originating the request shall provide an operator alert as a cue to conduct voice coordination.

C² JUs receiving a J7.2 message with the RV field set to value 3 shall automatically accept the requested correlation unless restrictions apply (e.g., different E/C, one simulated/one live, both locally derived real-time tracks), in which case the correlation shall be rejected.

C² JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if they have an Identity (ID) difference constituting a conflict, different Mode II codes (with local code current), both are locally derived real-time tracks, or either track has Strength > 1.
After decorrelation, a new Track Number (TN B) is assigned to the local track and reported in a J3.2 or J3.3 message.
The Retained TN and the Dropped TN are decorrelated such that if subjected to the decorrelation criteria once, the tracks would decorrelate, and the correlation shall be rejected.

If there is an OCC on the Dropped TN and the received RV field is set to value 0, the reverse correlation shall be transmitted if the new Dropped TN has no correlation constraint; if both Retained TN and Dropped TN have an OCC, the correlation shall be rejected.
If there is an OCC on the Dropped TN and the received RV field is set to value 1, the correlation shall be rejected.
C² JUs receiving or generating a J7.2 message with RV=2 (Correlation Rejection) shall not automatically originate a request with the same Retained TN and Dropped TN for a period of 2 minutes.
When a correlation request is rejected for a manual correlation, the JU originating the request shall provide an operator alert as a cue to conduct voice coordination.
